name: Hunch the Cream Tabby
blurb: Hunch, a fluffy cream-ginger tabby with a round face and big copper eyes, sits by the garden gate each morning and guesses which path visitors take.

name: Tossup the Cream Cat
blurb: Tossup, a pale-cream cat with a round face and wide copper eyes, sits between two flowerpots for ages deciding which to nap in, then naps in both.

name: Drizzle the Butterscotch Cat
blurb: Drizzle, a round-faced butterscotch tabby with big copper eyes, tucks under the porch just before each rain shower and waits for the first drops.
